purpose: Reviewer-facing provenance map for claims-control and migration-readiness methodology.
review_scope: Methodology, provenance, evidence classification, migration-readiness reasoning, and reproducible software behavior.

external_anchors.supported_use: Authoritative post-quantum standards and migration guidance.
Evidence that a major blockchain protocol has established a dated, multi-layer post-quantum migration target.

External scientific benchmark supporting migration-risk analysis.

allowed_claims: PROVEN INTERNALLY for exact-head tested software behavior
excluded_claims: independent validation until an external reviewer reproduces and records the result
original authorship of external scientific findings
